content:
jess: Quick sync — we have two microtrains next Tue: 09:00 PT and 15:00 PT. Need Deploy owner + Smoke owner + Rollback owner for each. Reply with the slot you can take and whether you can be on-call for the smoke window (~15m).

omar: I can take 09:00 PT as Deploy owner. Can do smoke.

chen: I can be Rollback owner for 09:00. Free that whole block.

katie: 15:00 PT I can deploy, but need someone to cover rollback — will be in meetings until 16:00.

ryan: I can be the rollback for 15:00. Also happy to be smoke owner if katie needs backup.

jess: Awesome — provisional owners: 09:00 -> omar (deploy), chen (rollback) ; 15:00 -> katie (deploy), ryan (rollback). Need smoke owners: omar already said yes, ryan offered backup for 15:00.

deploy-bot: Reminder: please attach 1) release checklist 2) smoke commands to the thread before EOD Fri. CI status: all tests passing on main.

omar: putting a short smoke checklist below and will attach to the calendar invite.

omar: ```
Smoke checklist (approx 10min)
- curl /health -> 200
- run sample inference for known prompt -> verify tokens within expected range
- check latency p50/p95 on recent 30m window -> <120ms p50
- tail logs for errors: 
  kubectl logs -l app=runtime -n prod --since=10m | grep -i error
```

chen: One ask — if we need to rollback, do we prefer model variant fallback or full image rollback? Suggest model fallback for faster recovery unless schema changes.

jess: Agreed — prefer model variant fallback if compatible. If db/migration or schema touches, then full rollback. We'll include decision tree in runbook.

katie: FYI the 15:00 deploy includes the new batching patch (PR #5421). It has a feature flag; will deploy with flag off and enable in canary.

ryan: Perfect. For canary enable flow: katie toggles flag for 5% traffic -> monitor errors for 10m -> 25% -> 100% if stable. I'll monitor metrics.

jess: Great. Last bits: please add your names to the calendar slot and attach the checklist / rollback commands. I'll set the post-deploy quick sync 10m after each slot. Thanks all :thumbsup:

omar: Added checklist to the invite and pinned the snippet here.

deploy-bot: Calendar updated: Tue 09:00 PT (microtrain A) and Tue 15:00 PT (microtrain B) added.

jess: Closing loop — if anything changes ping here. Otherwise we’re set.
